items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.

Responsible for BPEC office space: Maintain list of student desks, keep signage up to date, maintain office and kitchen supplies, handle maintenance requests to facilities, assist with furnishings and updates to rooms as needed.

Member company communication: Maintain and update e-mail lists, handle company on-boarding logistics, update content on members-only Box drive, schedule and announce webinars, help draft and proofread annual reports and regular company updates, maintain and update website.

Annual retreat: Schedule/book physical space, arrange catering, prepare meeting agenda and booklet, handle company registration and announcements, print name tags and coordinate on-site registration, setup promotional material, handle day-of logistics.
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff verbally and in writing.
Solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Working knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.

pay.source_text: budgeted salary or hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $30.58 to $36.71 hourly. This is a part-time (50% FTE) career position eligible for benefits. This position is FLSA
